title: Payment gateway requests timing out
description: Customer payment requests experienced elevated latency and frequent timeouts when calling the external payment gateway. Internal Payments endpoints remained healthy.
symptoms: HTTP 504 responses, gateway timeout exceptions, increased checkout failures and elevated external dependency latency.

title: Payment provider rate limiting
description: The Payments service received HTTP 429 responses from the external payment provider after transaction volume increased significantly.
symptoms: HTTP 429 responses, payment retries, increased payment latency and intermittent checkout failures.

title: Payment gateway authentication failure
description: Payment processing failed after an expired provider credential was deployed to the Payments service.
symptoms: HTTP 401 responses from the payment provider, authentication errors and failed checkout attempts.

title: Payments database connection exhaustion
description: The Payments service experienced database connection pool exhaustion during a traffic spike.
symptoms: SQL connection timeouts, slow payment processing and increased HTTP 500 responses.

title: Orders service downstream timeout
description: Order creation requests timed out while waiting for an external fulfilment provider.
symptoms: HTTP 504 responses, downstream timeout exceptions and elevated order creation latency.

title: Identity provider latency
description: Login requests became slow because calls to the external identity provider experienced elevated latency.
symptoms: Authentication timeouts, slow login requests and external dependency latency.

title: Payment gateway timeout in staging
description: Staging payment requests timed out because outbound connectivity to the payment provider was blocked by a network configuration change.
symptoms: Gateway connection timeouts, DNS and connectivity failures and HTTP 504 responses.

title: Product catalogue cache unavailable
description: The Products service could not reach its distributed cache and fell back to the primary data store.
symptoms: Cache connection errors, increased catalogue latency and elevated database load.
